title: Jubilant Dense Algerian Cornmeal Casserole
description: A hearty, salty casserole made with white cornmeal, chickpeas, tomatoes, and aromatic spices, perfect for a festive gathering.

ingredients.name: white cornmeal
ingredients.notes: stored in a dry sealed container

ingredients.name: dried chickpeas
ingredients.notes: soaked overnight and boiled until tender

instructions: Rinse chickpeas and soak overnight in a large bowl.
Drain, place chickpeas in a saucepan with 600ml water and ½ tsp salt, bring to a boil, simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
In a large bowl, combine boiled chickpeas with crushed sun‑dried tomatoes, diced onion, minced garlic, chopped parsley, ground cumin, and smoked paprika.
Stir in cornmeal gradually, adding water as needed until mixture thickens to a batter consistency.
Season with 1 tsp sea salt and ½ tsp black pepper, mix thoroughly.
Transfer batter to a greased baking dish, smooth the surface.
Bake for 35 minutes until the top turns golden brown.
Remove from oven, let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
